body:
`Check Changeset` is red on 20d75f11 for exactly the two reasons this PR's Acceptance notes name, and neither can be fixed from this PR:

- `check-adr-0087-registration --base`: three predicate-1 refusals. The gate maps only tsup's `dist/index.d.ts` -> `src/index.ts`, and `@object-ui/plugin-ai`'s entry is `src/index.tsx`. The fix is the gate change plus the ADR-0087 D9 wording on #26220 (`Blocked-by: #26220`).
- `check-empty-changeset --base`: the one-line removal of `"@object-ui/plugin-ai": minor` from the pending `.changeset/25831-object-ui-18-1-to-merge.md`. This is the DELIBERATE CORRECTION class: the package no longer exists, so restoring the line would make `changeset version` fail. The gate stays red until a maintainer confirms the edit; that confirmation has been asked for.

Every other step in the job passed: no major bump, the level axis reads `no (narrowing)` / `narrowed`, and protocol lockstep holds. No re-run: both failures are deterministic.

`Check Changeset` on bde1e722 (after merging `main` past the 18.2.0 release) has one red left. The `25831` correction is gone because 18.2 consumed that note, and `check-empty-changeset` is green.

The remaining red is `check-adr-0087-registration --base`: three predicate-1 refusals, `cannot be read at HEAD: no workspace manifest at HEAD is named @object-ui/plugin-ai`. The gate now maps the `.tsx` entry at the base. What it refuses is a whole-package removal, which leaves no HEAD manifest to read. This is a disposition decision for the maintainer (a D9 whole-package limb, or a `registered` disposition on this PR), so the marker stays as it is until that decision is made. No re-run: the failure is deterministic.

Ruling: the ADR-0087 gate on a whole-package deletion · letter A (a D9 whole-package clause) · maintainer 「同意」 2026-10-27T10:07Z

Recorded by the director seat (summon #51 continuation, `session_01KrKXQVvgYk2AJ4VkqMobyb`, ledger objectstack#12708), on the ui seat's question relayed by the maintainer (「定 plugin-ai 下线 #26365 的门禁问题：给 ADR-0087 D9 加整包删除条款，还是改用 `registered`？我倾向加条款」) and the maintainer's 「同意」 to the seat's analysis. Letter **A**: ADR-0087 D9 gains a whole-package clause — when a published package is deleted at HEAD, the operand is the package itself (`<package>#*`), the proof is "in the workspace with a published entry at the merge base; absent from the workspace at HEAD (no `package.json`, not in `pnpm-workspace.yaml`, not in the changesets fixed group)", and the FROM → TO block names the package on one line; the gate gains the matching predicate. Not B (`registered` names a conversion `os migrate meta` would apply; the three retired node types are refused by name with a remedy, not converted — a registered rewrite would delete the user's nodes silently) and not `not-required (unpublished)` (that disposition reads `private: true` at HEAD, which a deleted package cannot carry).

Execution: the spec lane that holds the gate (#26220, `pm:dispatched`) opens the ADR-0087 D9 amendment PR (Tier H, `docs/adr/**`) and the gate predicate PR (`scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs`), split per the mixed-diff rule or landed together by the maintainer's approval; this PR's changeset marker then takes the new spelling and `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main` goes green, after which #26365 lands by its own Tier H approval (over 3,000 lines). The two `skills/objectui/guides/*` mentions stay in their own governed follow-up as the body says. `Ruling-ref:` names this comment.

Head d81562ef merges `main` past #26766, the ADR-0087 D9 whole-package clause.

- **ADR-0087.** The changeset marker now reads `runtime-export-retired @object-ui/plugin-ai#*`, and the FROM → TO block names the package on a single line. `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main` passes locally: 1 declared-breaking changeset, carrying an ADR-0087 disposition.
- **Pending `.changeset/26080-readme-contributing-links.md`: deliberate correction, confirmed by the maintainer.** I removed one line from it, `'@object-ui/plugin-ai': patch`. With the line left in, `pnpm exec changeset status` exits 1 (`Found changeset 26080-readme-contributing-links for package @object-ui/plugin-ai which is not in the workspace`). With the line removed it exits 0. The package's README edit under that note left with the package. Steve confirmed the edit in the project thread with 「同意」 at 2026-10-28T03:32Z. `check-empty-changeset` stays red on this file by design.
- I also removed the `@object-ui/plugin-ai` row from the `CONTRIBUTING.md` package table, which #27001 had just added.
- **Local verification.** The Console and CLI builds succeed (71/71 and 62/62). Vitest over types, i18n, cli, scripts and components: 942 files, 19881 tests, all passing. `sdui.manifest.json` is unchanged.
